semantics.timing: Original explicitly requires a combinational circuit; no clock, reset, state, or cycle latency.
semantics.initialization: No initialization specified; outputs follow current inputs.

numeric.width: All ports one bit as explicitly specified.
numeric.interpretation: Boolean gates; bitwise Verilog operators preserve normal four-state gate propagation.

verification.oracle: Literal truth table independently derived from the seven gate descriptions in problem.txt.
verification.cases: All four binary input combinations, repeated transitions, plus supplemental four-state controlling-value cases.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then wait 1 ns for combinational settling; no edge-based sampling is specified.
verification.failure: Case inequality, fatal mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: X/Z behavior is not explicitly specified; use conventional Verilog gate semantics and mark four-state tests supplemental.
